MCTS HF Services - MCTS MF Services - MCTS VHF Services - Arctic, Great Slave Lake, Mackenzie
Iqaluit MCTS. Due to annual solar decay, all satellite remote controlled and local facilities located at Iqaluit, Churchill, Resolute, Cambridge Bay, Inuvik, Hay River, Enterprise and Yellowknife could be off air daily between 1802UTC and 1826UTC from 11 to 17 Oct 2026.
